pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with defined but soft-gradient edges. The patches on the mid-flank and lower neck are predominantly quadrilateral and pentagonal with a large spatial area relative to the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological lattice of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes exhibit clear multi-directional intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and uniform across the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck, formed by short, densely packed vertical mane fibers.
